foreshadowing: Wolf hasn't eaten in a while.

wolf: Time slips away, dear; do you remember how long Grandmother has been ailing? It would be a tragedy if such good intentions were slowed by a longer, twisty road.
Your hurry is real, and any detour would be a tragedy for your good intentions. My careful path will keep us moving faster and safer—shall we take it together?
Well spotted, and a bitter truth: my careful way is gentler on the ground and quicker for Grandmother. I would be glad to share it with you.
red: Before dawn I woke, fearing Grandmother might be worse, and I moved as fast as I could. I want to be brave and true to my promise to reach her.
I see a seam in the moss there, a secret someone tried to hide with leaves.
I won't tell anyone, and stepping over the root-line with you feels right when trust is offered and a shorter path glimmers ahead.
